_description: Example activation cases for node .claude/scripts/skill-activation-eval.mjs. Copy it, then write prompts the way your least technical user types them. expect = the skill folder that should start, or null when no framework skill should start. Include near-misses that must stay quiet. Each case is a live, read-only headless host run in this project (Claude: plan mode, only the Skill, Read, Glob and Grep tools, project and local settings only; Codex: read-only sandbox); framework mode switches such as CK_FRAMEWORK_MODE reach the run and the report records the effective mode; a run that errors or times out is unmeasured and makes the command exit 2.

cases.prompt: save my changes with a good commit message
what did the last commit change?
open a pull request for this branch
summarise the comments on my pull request
what does the regular expression ^a+$ match?
